name: Aftermath Crumble
source:
As a successful manager, Chris knows how to play his opponents, but when the death game crumbles, all bets are off.

[From [url=https://nothackeuropa.home.blog/]NotHack Europa[/url]]
translation:
Chris是一名成功的经理，深谙如何与对手周旋；然而，死亡游戏一旦崩盘，一切便都失控了。

[来源：[url=https://nothackeuropa.home.blog/]NotHack Europa[/url]]
